items.title: Present tense of be
items.notesAr:
نستخدم be لنقول من هو الشخص أو ما هو الشيء، ولنسأل أسئلة شخصية.
I ← am (I'm)
He / She / It ← is (He's / She's / It's)
You / We / They ← are (You're / We're / They're)
ملكية في الرسالة: my = خاصتي، our = خاصتنا، their = خاصتهم.
rules: I'm Sam. = I am Sam.
You're/We're/They're from the UK. = You/We/They are from the UK.
He's/She's a website developer. = He/She is a website developer.
It's in the US. = It is in the US.
examples: What's his name/job? = What is his name/job?
Eli and Guido are system maintenance officers.

items.title: Present simple
items.notesAr:
نستخدم المضارع البسيط للروتين وللأشياء الدائمة أو التي تحدث دائماً.
مع I / you / we / they: do (سؤال) و don't (نفي).
مع he / she / it: does (سؤال) و doesn't (نفي) ويضاف s للفعل: works.
الإجابة المختصرة: Yes, I do. / No, I don't.
rules: What do you do? I'm a programmer.
What does she do? She's a developer.
Where does she work? She works for IBM in Poland. She doesn't work in Estonia.
Where do they work? They work for Siemens in Egypt.
Do you work in IT? Yes, I do. / No, I don't.

items.title: Schedules
items.notesAr:
نستخدم at مع الساعة.
السؤال: What time does it start / begin / finish / end?
start = begin (يبدأ) ، finish = end (ينتهي).
للاستراحة: When do you have a break? We have a break at 12.45.
rules: It starts at 9.15. (nine fifteen / quarter past nine)
It begins at 8.30. (eight thirty / half past eight)
It finishes at 4.00. (four o'clock)
It ends at 5.05. (five oh five / five past five)
We have a break at 12.45. (twelve forty-five / a quarter to one)
examples: I start work at 8.15 and finish about 5.00.

items.title: Acronyms and spelling
items.notesAr:
Acronym = كلمة مكوّنة من الحروف الأولى لاسم شيء ما.
stand for = يمثّل / يرمز إلى.
السؤال: What does X stand for / mean؟ الجواب: It stands for / means ...
الحرف Z يُنطق zed في البريطانية و zee في الأمريكية.
rules: What does CD stand for? It stands for Compact Disc.
What does IP mean? It means Internet Protocol.
How do you spell 'Protocol'? p-r-o-t-o-c-o-l.
examples: What does P2P stand for? P2P stands for person-to-person.
What does HTML stand for? HyperText Markup Language.

items.title: Comparatives
items.notesAr:
نستخدم المقارنة للمقارنة بين شخصين أو شيئين.
الصفات القصيرة: نضيف er ثم than (انتبه للتهجئة: big → bigger، easy → easier، heavy → heavier).
الصفات الطويلة: more / less ثم than.
شاذة: good → better ، bad → worse.
rules: big → bigger: The new monitor was bigger than the old monitor.
fast → faster: Your processor is faster than mine.
easy → easier: It's easier to use than the other one.
difficult → more/less difficult: This version is more difficult to use than the old version.
expensive → more/less expensive: His computer is less expensive than hers.
reliable → more/less reliable: It is more reliable than the one you have.
bad → worse: That screen resolution is much worse than before!
good → better: It's so much better than the old one.
examples: The Corsair is faster than the Imation.
The Corsair is more durable than the Imation.

items.title: Superlatives
items.notesAr:
نستخدم صيغة التفضيل لمقارنة شخص أو شيء بعدد من الأشخاص أو الأشياء الأخرى.
الصفات القصيرة: the + est (big → the biggest، easy → the easiest).
الصفات الطويلة: the most / the least.
شاذة: bad → the worst ، good → the best.
rules: big → the biggest: The new monitor was the biggest in the room.
fast → the fastest: Your version of the software is the fastest.
easy → the easiest: It's the easiest to use.
difficult → the most/least difficult: This version is the most difficult to use.
expensive → the most/least expensive: His computer is the least expensive.
reliable → the most/least reliable: It is the most reliable.
bad → the worst: That is the worst software I've ever used!
good → the best: It's the best I've seen.
